question: I want to save €3000 for a trip. How long will it take?
title: How long a goal takes

cells.title: A savings goal at your usual pace
cells.code:
AMOUNT, KEY = float(§AMOUNT§), "§NAME§"
NAMES = {"trip": ("trip", "for the trip"), "car": ("car", "for the car"), "laptop": ("laptop", "for the laptop"), "phone": ("phone", "for the phone"), "wedding": ("wedding", "for the wedding"), "home": ("home", "for the home"), "bike": ("bike", "for the bike"), "sofa": ("sofa", "for the sofa"), "christmas": ("Christmas", "for Christmas"), "buffer": ("buffer", "for the buffer"), "goal": ("goal", "for the goal")}
MON = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"]
gname, gfor = NAMES.get(KEY, NAMES["goal"])
g = kori.goal(AMOUNT, gname)
room, months = g.get("usual_month_leaves") or 0.0, g.get("months_at_usual_room")
emit("amount", AMOUNT, "eur", "The goal")
emit("room", round(room, 2), "eur_per_month", "A usual month leaves")
ok = g.get("verdict") == "no_date" and months and 0 < months <= 120 and room > 0
if ok:
    reached = str(g["reached_at_usual_room"])
    emit("months", months, "months", "Months at that pace")
    reached_in = reached
    emit("reached", reached, "text", "Together around")
    emit("reached_in", reached_in, "text", "Together around")
    emit("goal_for", gfor, "text", "What it is for")
    table("path", [{"month": k, "saved": round(min(AMOUNT, room * k), 2)} for k in range(0, months + 1)], "Saved month by month at that pace")
    say(f"At your usual pace it takes **{months} months**: a usual month leaves you {eur(room)} after everything, so you would have {eur(AMOUNT)} {gfor} around {reached_in}.")
